text:
maria: Hey team — opened a small PR to consolidate the rate-cap examples + dashboard links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123
maria: Main ask: update the 'per-tier consumption' example to show burst credits being applied, and fix the Grafana panel link breaking on prod.
josh: taking a look now. Is the example expected to show both per-minute and monthly aggregation? :thinking:
sam: @josh yes — show minute-level for latency-sensitive clients and monthly for billing previews. I pushed a suggested snippet to the PR that uses the new SDK header example: `X-Redwood-Usage: {"units":1,"type":"token"}`
maria: thanks @sam. Also we need to ensure the snippet uses the SDKv2 call shape (see migration guide) — otherwise users will copy the old header format.
frank: quick nit — the Grafana link in the docs points to `/d/usage/usage-overview?panelId=3` but in prod our panel id changed to 7. I'll add a redirect note in the PR and open an ops ticket if we need permanent redirect.
josh: I ran the linter, docs build passes locally but the examples break on the playground because of a sample API key. I'll replace with `api_key: <REDACTED>` and add a `curl` inline example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -d '{"prompt":"..."}'
```
maria: perfect. For the pricing table, can someone sanity-check the tier names? I switched 'startup' -> 'growth' to match product copy.
sam: looks good. One more item: update the 'quota behavior' section to clarify burst exhaustion flow and fallback model routing — customers kept pinging support about automatic downgrade behavior.
frank: added a 2-line note under 'Fallbacks' + a link to the routing policy doc. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: Deployed preview site: https://deploy-preview-4123--docs.redwood.ai — please review the panel links on staging and post screenshots if flaky.
maria: I'll review preview and merge if green. Plan to ship before EOD to sync with release cut.
